string.text: Adult Content Level

How much romantic/intimate content NPCs may express. Off, Mature (romance, nothing explicit), Explicit, or Hardcore. A child can be conceived only at Explicit or above. Applies on your next conversation.
Conception Chance (%)

Chance that an intimate act able to make a child (Explicit or above) leads to one. 15 is the shipped chance; 100 makes every such act conceive. Her age and a recent birth still count. Applies immediately.
Prompt Profile
Which prompt profile composes what characters read: stock, your own (Custom/Prompts) or one a mod ships (cr_prompts). Stock is the reset. cr.prompt_check lists what each profile changes.
Chat Window Style

The look of the conversation window. Origin is the original panel; Dark Leather is the illuminated leather book. Both are the same conversation, only the look differs. Applies on your next conversation.
Dark Leather
Chat Text Size (%)

Scales ONLY the dialogue text in the chat window, not the window itself: a smaller value fits more words per line, a larger one reads easier. 100 is the shipped size. Applies on your next conversation.
Dark Leather Size (%)
Scales the Dark Leather chat window. Raise it on a high-resolution screen (1440p+) if the book feels small or cramped. 100 is the shipped size. No effect on the Origin skin.
Council Size (%)

Scales the council window independently of the chat size above. The council book is wider, so on a 1440p or larger screen it can feel too big: lower it if it overflows, raise it if it feels small. 100 is the shipped size.
Council Text Size (%)
Scales ONLY the dialogue text in the council (round-table) window, INDEPENDENTLY of the chat text size above. 100 is the shipped size. Applies to the next council.
Marriage Regard Needed

Regard a lord or lady must hold for you before accepting a LOVE-MATCH marriage (their personal regard or your clan relation, whichever is higher). 50 is the shipped bar. Their family's blessing can still open a match below it. Applies immediately.
Regard Warmth Cooldown (days)

How long warmth settles before it can deepen again. Each point of regard costs one more warm moment than the last, and a step relaxes after this many days. 0 turns it off: warmth never gets dearer. 7 is the default. Applies immediately.
OpenRouter API Key
Paste your key from openrouter.ai/keys. Stored locally on this machine only. NEVER share your config file or a screenshot of this field. Applies immediately.
Pin Providers (advanced)

Leave blank unless needed. Some providers censor their own output, cutting replies mid-sentence. Pinning also steadies prompt caching, which lowers cost: unpinned, OpenRouter may switch provider mid-session and the cache is lost. Comma separated.
Pin Providers (NSFW)
Blank reuses the pin above. Set a different provider only for explicit scenes, e.g. cheapest routing for chat and an uncensored provider for scenes.
Allow provider fallbacks
Only matters with providers pinned above. OFF (default) makes the pin a hard rule. ON lets OpenRouter fall back to others when yours are unavailable.
Lords can ride in your party

On (default): an idle lord or lady of another clan may agree to ride IN your party for a time, keeping their own house. Off: only the follow_me escort (their own party riding alongside yours) remains. cr.retainer enable overrides for the session.
Characters can add news to the world

Off (default): what a character invents stays in that conversation. On: a blight, brigands, a death or an omen they mention can become a real rumour others may hear. Never numbers, money, or who holds what - the game owns those.
NPCs can end conversations

On (default): when a character ends a conversation the chat closes and you click Leave. Off: their goodbye no longer closes it, so you can have the last word and close it yourself. Captivity scenes keep their own flow.
Enable Council

When ON, you can convene a council of companions, kin, clan lords or a war council from a town, castle or village menu, and from a button on the campaign map while on land. OFF hides those entry points; the console can still open it.
Strategic Assessment (AI)

On (default): the Strategic Assessment is written by your highest-Tactics companion (a warband soldier if you have none), and the sharper their Tactics the better the counsel. Off, or alone: a plain summary, no AI call.
Council Voices

Default for a new council (flip it in the council window). One call for the table keeps the scene cohesive but voices the others from little more than a name. One call per member gives each their real memory and regard, at a round-trip apiece.
One call for the table
One call per member
Companion contentment

When ON, a neglected companion grows restless, asks for an audience, and if you keep refusing eventually leaves by letter, never silently. Also gates the occasional found-topic audience. OFF disables both entirely.
Contentment Pacing
How fast companions get over a grievance: Forgiving, Balanced (default), or Exacting. In every setting, a companion left merely idle NEVER leaves you.
Companions Asking For A Word

How often a travelling companion asks for a private word, in a settlement or on the road. Never switches it off. Occasionally is the shipped feel. With The World's Initiative on, it sets how much of its turns companions get.
API Key (optional)
Leave blank for keyless local servers like LM Studio or Ollama. Fill it in only if your server requires one. Applies immediately.
Endpoint URL (Prose / shared)

Base URL of your local server, with /v1 (e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1). Serves the Prose role, and any role whose own Endpoint below is blank. Set that role's model under LLM Provider too, or it sends an OpenRouter id to your server.
Endpoint URL (NSFW)
Optional. A separate OpenAI-Compatible server URL for the NSFW role only, so you can split roles across two local machines. Blank = use the shared Endpoint URL above. Applies immediately.
Endpoint URL (Background)
Optional. A separate OpenAI-Compatible server URL for the mod's background work only (summaries, memory compression). Leave blank to use the same server as everything else.
Endpoint URL (Interpret)
Optional. A separate OpenAI-Compatible server URL for the Interpret role only, so the interpreter can run on its own local machine. Blank = use the shared Endpoint URL above. Applies immediately.
Parameter Compatibility
Which sampling parameters to send. Auto detects OpenAI reasoning models (gpt-5, o1/o3/o4), which reject the classic max_tokens. Leave on Auto unless your endpoint rejects a field.
Reasoning Effort

Sends reasoning_effort to a local or OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Set Off if a reasoning model spends the whole reply budget thinking and stalls. Default sends nothing. Some servers (vLLM) ignore it; Verbose Logging shows what was sent.
API Key (NSFW)
Optional. A separate API key for the NSFW role only, so it can authenticate against a different OpenAI-Compatible server than the shared one. Blank = use the API Key above. Applies immediately.
API Key (Background)
Optional. A separate API key for the mod's background work only. Leave blank to use the same key as everything else.
API Key (Interpret)
Optional. A separate API key for the Interpret role only, so the interpreter can authenticate against its own OpenAI-Compatible server. Blank = use the API Key above. Applies immediately.
Enable File Logging
Writes the mod's diagnostics to CalradiaRemembers.log (only the last two sessions are kept, so the file never grows without bound). Off by default; turn on to capture a bug report.
Enable On-Screen Logging

Also prints the mod's diagnostics as on-screen messages (top-left). Off by default: the stream can crowd the screen during play. Turn it on only when you want to watch the mod live; the file log above is the better channel for a bug report.
Report button in the chat

Shows a button in the chat window to report a problem: you describe it and see the whole report (conversation, prompts, replies, log), saved to a file you share on Discord and written into the log. Nothing is sent by itself.
Enable Jealousy

On (default): the world is richer, partners react to being favoured or slighted, a neglected co-partner can feel wronged, and open-relationship pacts matter. Off: a drama-free household, no jealousy of any kind, from any partner.
Enable Stolen Love

Off (default): a married character resists an affair as before. On: seducing a MARRIED character is a gated, personality-true path (an honourable or content one holds firm however high your standing). Explicit content follows Adult Content Level.
Allow killing characters

Off (default): you may rob or beat someone in conversation, never kill. On: a killing attempt is possible, never a formality (it turns on how you compare and whether they are alone). The world answers: a crime, lost standing, kin who remember.
Arrests and outlaws

Off (default). On: as a vassal or mercenary, a grave act brings a warrant: face your liege's council or flee as an outlaw with a price on your head. Robbing merchants in peace makes you a brigand. Never a ruler. Off lifts every bounty.
Mercenary departures are judged

On (default): when a contract ends, the realm's lords judge it. Leaving a losing war, or going to its enemy, costs their regard, which fades over a year. A contract renewed within days is no departure. Off: never judged.
Vassal war duty

Off (default). On: a sworn vassal (never a mercenary) who sits out the realm's war is summoned by the ruler to answer for it, then asked a levy in coin, or troops, horses or arms instead, and may lose a fief by giving nothing.
War duty window (days)
Days of war a sworn vassal may go without fighting for the realm (a battle, a siege, a day in its army) before the ruler calls them to account. Default 30.
War levy scale (%)
Scales the levy a ruler asks of a vassal who did not fight (it grows with clan tier and fiefs held, at most 10,000 per hand-over). 100 = as designed.
Clan standing warms first meetings

On (default): when you next speak with someone whose clan already counts you a friend, they start warmer toward you, once, up to friendly regard; the rest is earned in person. An offence stands. Off: regard starts from zero.
Show secret memories
Lists in a character's Memories panel the secrets other mods give them (an affair, a hidden fondness), marked secret. Off by default, so you learn them in play rather than by reading the panel.
Edicts of the world's lords

Off (default). On: the world's lords decree edicts on their own towns, and rulers on their realms, to answer a sore need (hunger, unrest, lawlessness), told as realm news. Your own edicts work either way.
Lords play the realm's strategy

Off (default). On: when one realm grows far too strong, lords of the other realms put war, peace, alliances and calls to arms against it to their realm's vote, and plot against houses grown too strong, yours included.
Post-duel conversation

On (default): after a duel the conversation reopens and resumes what led to it. The loser concedes (a beaten character of honour may grant a favour you ask); the victor says what they now expect. Off: only the duel's consequences apply.
Compact prompt for small models

Trims the prompt to fit a SMALL, short-context model (4k to 8k). Turn ON if the AI stays silent: the full prompt is overflowing it. Replies grow less richly grounded, and fewer tasks are offered. Leave OFF for cloud models.
LLM Provider
Local model context (tokens)

0 = off (cloud models). For a local/custom server: the context length set there, per request. CR then trims each request to fit it (oldest lines first, then the compact prompt) instead of the server cutting it blind.
Compress old memories

Lets characters fold old, superseded memories into a short outline, so a long campaign stops inflating every prompt (the usual cause of slow replies on a local model). First meetings, recent events and grave moments are never dropped.
Memories in the prompt
Most memories of you a character reads in each prompt, the latest kept. 0 = all (Compact keeps 6 at most). Lower it if a small local model drowns in a long history. Every memory stays saved.
Compress after (memories)
How many memories a character holds before old, superseded ones are folded into an outline (default 24). Lower keeps prompts short on a local model; each fold costs one background call.
Chat Temperature

How varied conversation replies are (default 0.70). Lower is steadier and more repetitive, higher more surprising; above 1.0 a local model may lose its character. Reasoning models ignore it. Applies immediately.
Reply Token Budget

Most tokens a conversation reply may use. 0 = Auto (3000, 1200 in Compact). A reasoning model counts its thinking in it: raise it if it is cut off mid-thought. On a local server it shares the context window.
Presence Penalty
How hard conversation replies avoid repeating words (default 0.50). 0 sends none, for a local model it hurts. Higher is more varied but may drift off names. Reasoning models ignore it.
Other mods may use my connection
On (default): a mod built on Calradia Remembers (a diplomacy mod, say) may send its own requests through your model and key; each is logged with its name. Off: none can, and they are told so.
LLM Response Timeout (s)

How long to wait for a reply, in seconds (default 120), in conversations and for letters and summaries (never under 60). Raise it for a slow local or reasoning model; lower it to fail fast. Applies immediately.
PROSE model

Model id in the ACTIVE provider's own format (OpenRouter: x-ai/grok-4.20; NanoGPT: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3; Ollama: llama3.1:8b). Writes ordinary chat, and in Enhanced mode the prose of every scene. Applies immediately.
Roleplay / Prose provider
Which provider the roleplay and prose model above is sent to. It is also the base every other role inherits when left on (default). Each provider keeps its own key further down. Applies immediately.
NanoGPT API Key
Paste your key from nano-gpt.com. Stored locally on this machine only. NEVER share your config file or a screenshot of this field.
Chat Composition

Where a fresh session's in-chat Enhanced/Roleplay switch starts. Enhanced (default): the prose model writes and the interpret model tags, richest but slower. Standard: one call, cheapest and fastest. The in-chat switch overrides it for the session.
NSFW model

Model id for explicit content: captivity in Standard mode, the fallback in Enhanced. Blank uses the PROSE model - and so does the shipped OpenRouter id if you point this role at your own server without naming ITS model.
NSFW provider
Which provider the NSFW model above is sent to. (default) uses the PROSE provider. Applies immediately.
Background model

Optional. A cheaper or smaller chat model (not an embedding model) for the mod's background work: summaries, memory compression, claim extraction. Blank uses the roleplay model. Useful on a local server, where two prompts share one cache.
Background provider
Which provider the Background model above is sent to. (default) uses the PROSE provider.
Interpret model

Enhanced mode only: the model that reads the structured actions out of the prose. Blank uses the PROSE model - and so does the shipped OpenRouter id if you point this role at your own server without naming ITS model.
Interpret provider
Which provider the Interpret model above is sent to. (default) uses the PROSE provider (set it to a local OpenAI-Compatible endpoint to run the interpreter locally). Applies immediately.
Reasoning Effort (NSFW)
Reasoning effort while the chat is in NSFW mode. Lower or Off makes a reasoning model far less prone to moralizing refusals, and speeds up scenes. OpenRouter and NanoGPT.
Same as prose
Reasoning Effort (PROSE)

How hard the PROSE model thinks before replying. Higher can mean finer dialogue but slower replies, more truncation and more refusals on adult content; keep it Low or Medium. Grok 4 only thinks or not: Low means Off there. OpenRouter and NanoGPT.
Relationship Pacing

How relationships grow through conversation: a philosophy, not a difficulty. Grounded keeps the core game's feel; Warm rewards good company; Storyteller is roleplay-first. Insults cost the same everywhere.
Reply Language

Leave blank to use the game's language (an English game mirrors whatever language you write in). Name a language (e.g. Spanish) to force every reply, letter, memory, and the illuminated chronicle into it, no matter what you write.
Reply Length

How long characters' replies run. Full is the length the mod has always used (3 to 7 sentences, longer for a story). Balanced: 2 to 4. Short: 1 to 3, always. Counted in sentences, so a reply is never cut off mid-way.
NPCs Raise World News

Off (default): an NPC approaches you only about something between the two of you. On: they may also stop you to ask what you make of distant news. Their own deeds and yours are always allowed either way.
Characters Set The Scene

On (default): when you start a conversation, the character opens it, what they were doing and their first words, while you may already type. One more model call per conversation. Off: the short greeting alone.
Scene Narration
On (default): conversations carry short purple descriptions of the place, the light and the sounds. Off: the characters' words and gestures alone. Captive scenes keep their narration either way.
Long Memory

Off (default). On: before each reply, a character recalls the exact words of earlier talks they were present for, when they bear on what is said now. Costs prompt tokens (see the budget). Full prompt only.
Long Memory Budget (characters)
How many characters of earlier words a reply may recall, at most. 4000 (default) is about 1,000 tokens per reply. Used only with Long Memory on.
Lords Approaching You

How often a lord rides out to have a word with you on the road. Never switches it off entirely. Occasionally is the shipped feel. With The World's Initiative on, it sets how much of its turns lords get.
Authored Quests (experimental)

Experimental, off by default. On: characters may ask your help with a written tale (a quest in several stages, like the wolf of the wood). Off: no new tale is offered; one under way goes on (cr.story_abandon sets it aside).
Lords Hold Their Course

On: a lord riding out to speak with you holds his course until he reaches you, or gives up after a few days. Off: as before 2.6.8, he may turn back to his own affairs and lose interest quickly. Applies to the next chase.
Ask Which Companions Come Along

Off (default): a conversation opens with whoever is truly there; bring a companion, a lord riding with you or a prisoner in with the Invite button. On: as before 2.7.5, each conversation first asks which companions come along.
NPC Cross-Talk

How many times NPCs may talk amongst themselves (one reacting to another) before the turn comes back to you, in a scene with witnesses. 2 is the default; 0 turns it off so only the NPC you spoke to replies. Applies on your next message.
Invulnerable Couriers
Off: couriers can be intercepted by bandits or by the sender's enemies. A lost letter is sent again, and what it said travels with its captors to whoever beats them. On: no interception.
Letter Riders on the Map

On: a rider carries each letter to you across the map. Off: no rider comes; a letter reaches your box on its date instead and cannot be intercepted on the way. Riders already out turn back within a day. Your own letters still ride.
Unasked Letters

Off: characters stop writing of their own accord. Still come: replies to your letters, war summons and levies, divorce, news of your children and their support, blackmail, threats, a courtship's answer, patrol reports, farewells, other mods' letters.
Write Letters on Arrival

On: each letter is written as it reaches your box, so it opens at once. Off: written when you open it, so a letter you throw away or never open costs nothing. The text is as of the day it was sent either way.
Captor Conversations
A lord who holds you may send for you to talk: courtesy, a ransom, an oath, an exchange. At most one a week, at every content level. Off: no such scene.
Friends May Spare Your Villages
When a war sets a friend or relative against you, they draw once: the closer they are, the likelier they leave your villages alone. Off: every lord raids as in the base game.

A battle won against the odds, a siege held or a last stand can become a legend that characters tell in their own way, yours included. At most one a season, your own excepted. Off: no new legend, none told.
Hidden Affairs Among Lords
Now and then a married lord takes a hidden lover, a handful at most. Send a companion to spy on a lord to find out. A found affair can be used or told. Off: no new affair. Never at adult content Off.
Allow Captor Executions
Let a captor's scene end your character, at their own deliberate choice, deep in a Hardcore captive scene. Off by default. Irreversible: game over, or your heir succeeds you.
Allow Fief And Marriage Quest Rewards
Let a lord promise one of their own fiefs, or a marriage into their house, as a quest reward, delivered when you complete it. Off by default.
Story Log
Writes a clean narrative transcript of every conversation and letter to CalradiaRemembers_story.log in your Logs folder. No timestamps, no noise: it reads like a novel.
Report unsupported actions

Shows a note in chat when the AI attempts an action the mod does not support yet. Every attempt is logged to CalradiaRemembers_unknown_actions.log regardless of this setting. Send that log to LogRaam on Nexus to request support.
Test Connection
Validates your key, then sends a one-token test to the roleplay model and, if set, the NSFW model, reporting any error. Costs a fraction of a cent.
Test Endpoint
Sends a one-token test to your endpoint with the roleplay model and, if set, the NSFW model. Your server must be running. OpenAI-Compatible only.
Test NanoGPT Connection
Checks your NanoGPT key against nano-gpt.com without starting a conversation. No tokens spent.
Self-Esteem Climb

How hard a character's pride climbs once already high. 0: every success counts in full, as before. 2 (default): half way up, a victory counts a quarter; near the top, almost nothing. Higher: harder still. Applies immediately.
Use custom traits
Applies the hand-authored personalities from ModuleData/character_overrides.json, replacing an authored NPC's five vanilla traits. Edits load on the next campaign, or via cr.reload_lore.
Custom Folder Path

Where your edited prompts and styles are read from. Blank = the mod's own ModuleData/Custom. An absolute path keeps them outside the mod so an update never wipes them (re-enter it afterwards). Applies on the next campaign or cr.reload_lore.
Verbose Logging
Logs the full system prompt and NPC reply on every exchange. Turn on only to capture a bug report: it floods the log. Requires Enable Logging.
Witness Density

How many ambient bystanders a conversation gathers. Sparse thins the room fast; Normal keeps a genuine middle ground; Bustling (default) is today's full room, unchanged. Never touches companions you bring yourself. Applies on your next conversation.
Women In The Ranks

Some soldiers in battle are women: a quarter in Sturgia, Battania and the Khuzait, a tenth among the Nords and the Southern Empire, none elsewhere. Shares in women_in_ranks.json. Turn off if another mod already does this.
How Often the World Comes to You
One conductor decides whose turn it is to come to you unasked (lords, companions, tales...). Off: each paces itself, as before. Custom uses the settings below.
The World's Initiative
At Once (Custom)
How many of them may be at you at the same time, e.g. a lord riding after you and a word asked in town. Custom only.
Interruptions per Window (Custom)
How many times the world may come to you within the window below. A letter that asks for a turn counts as set further down. Custom only.
Window (days, Custom)
The span, in game days, the interruptions above are counted over. Custom only.
Time Between Two (hours, Custom)
The least time, in game hours, between two interruptions. Custom only.
Settling Delay (hours, Custom)
How long the world waits, in game hours, after a battle or a conversation ends before it comes to you. Custom only.
Quiet After Your Own Talk (hours, Custom)
After a conversation you opened yourself, the world leaves you alone this many game hours. Custom only.
How far a kind that just came to you steps back so the others get their turn. The world's urgent matters are not affected.
Requests Expire After (days)
A wish to come to you that waited this many game days is dropped, like stale news. The world's urgent matters never expire.
Letters Count As
Most letters ask for no turn. This is what the few that do cost from the count above: a lord's friendship or threat, a companion's farewell, a divorce demand.
A Full Interruption
Urgent Matters Wait Their Turn
Off (default): an arrest, your liege's war summons, an ambush or an envoy with a short deadline comes whenever the moment allows. On: they wait their turn like the rest.
Weight: Lords (%)
How much lords seeking a word or riding out to you weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
Weight: Companions (%)
How much your companions asking for a word weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
Weight: Household (%)
How much your spouse and kin weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
Weight: Tales (%)
How much written tales offered on the map weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
Weight: War and Law (%)
How much war and the law (not the urgent matters) weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
Weight: Lords' Aims (%)
How much lords putting a matter of their own to you weigh when the turn is drawn. 0 turns them off; 100 is even. Each still gets a turn a month when it waits.
